compatibility.selection: Available paired upstream source releases, not equivalent numeric versions or a reconstruction of the unavailable vendor native addons.
compatibility.ffiJavaScript: Ignoring CRLF, all thirteen vendor ffi-napi lib files match upstream except dynamic_library.js and foreign_function.js: vendor ref.isAddress accepts PointerBuffer, upstream accepts genuine Buffer pointers.
compatibility.refJavaScript: Vendor ref adds PointerBuffer prototype methods and native int32 helpers, broadens allocCString null handling, and uses _attach after _writePointer; upstream 3.0.3 uses Buffer pointers and its own _writePointer(..., true) lifetime attachment. Never mix either release JS with the other release native addon.
compatibility.consumerEvidence: NativeIntegration/ffi.js, its library.js override and meeting_renderer.js use Library/DynamicLibrary.get/ForeignFunction/Callback and Buffer-compatible pointers. This does not prove compatibility with dynamically constructed or obfuscated names; acceptance against the exact user-supplied application remains required.
compatibility.abiPolicy: Unmodified libffi Linux ia32 SYSV/default ABI and platform exports; no fabricated STDCALL/WIN32 aliases.
compatibility.externalBuffers: The upstream ref addon uses actual external ArrayBuffers. This build is only for the real Linux ia32 runtime, not a V8 sandboxed/x64 substitute.
compatibility.libraryOverride: Not applied here. Parent applies NativeIntegration/app-overrides/libraries/node_extends/node-ffi/ffi-napi/lib/library.js after assembly.
